295:t_026:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$アーバレスト$$! Is $$宗介$$ here too!?」

295:t_026:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...A reunion on Mars... We can't call this a coincidence.」

295:t_026:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they, too, were tossed about by a great power, just as we were...」

295:t_026:7.en:
$$万丈$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... And the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...)

295:t_027:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm not saying scream and cry, but you could at least act a little shaken!」

295:t_027:2.en:
$$レド$$
「He's beyond the level of a calm soldier...! Is he... even human!?」

295:t_027:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Don't worry. I'm human, same as you.」

295:t_027:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Cut me and I bleed, and someday I will die...」

295:t_027:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry, but I'm not about to believe words like that!」

295:t_027:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Then try to defeat me. If you can.」

295:t_027:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You don't have to tell me that...!」

295:t_028:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...I apologize, $$尸空#pilot$$. I am withdrawing.」

295:t_029:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Your woman gets taken down and you don't even bat an eye!」

295:t_029:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I may have said this before, but that is not our relationship.」

295:t_029:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Still, that's a relief! He's human too!」

295:t_029:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then there has to be a way to fight him! Let's do it!」

295:t_100:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've been dying to see you, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

295:t_100:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Not even Darling's Heat Smile and fiery advances faze him at all!」

295:t_100:3.en:
$$メール$$
「If it were me, I'd be totally smitten~!」

295:t_100:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Not even $$メール$$'s tone-deaf gags faze him at all!」

295:t_100:9.en:
$$メール$$
「Hmph! Next time I'll come with fresher material and take you on!」

295:t_100:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's not the point, $$メール$$!」

295:t_100:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...I can't put up with this.」

295:t_101:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$セツコ・オハラ$$. I will be your opponent in place of $$バルビエル$$.」

295:t_101:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Why...? Even on $$翠の地球$$, $$バルビエル$$ was fixated on me...)

295:t_101:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Could it be that the key to defeating him lies there...!?)

295:t_102:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$... I can't let you fall into his hands.」

295:t_102:1.en:
$n
「I belong to no one...! I won't let you have your way with me either!」

295:t_102:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I see... I can indeed sense potential in you.」

295:t_102:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's a shame that I have to reap it before it awakens.」

295:t_103:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You look shaken, $$沈黙の巨蟹$$. At this rate, the name of the Third Stage Reactor will weep.」

295:t_103:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You've killed your emotions, then. I'll give you credit for that, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

295:t_104:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You certainly did a number on us at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

295:t_104:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$... Your darkness is deep and cold...」

295:t_104:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I wonder which is darker, the $$無限獄$$ where I was or your void...!」

295:t_105:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Do you mean to fight us for the sake of revenge for a family whose fate was twisted?」

295:t_105:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I will not become a $$メガノイド$$ bound by ego...! So I have no intention of fighting for revenge!」

295:t_105:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! Whoever would shroud the world in darkness will face $$破嵐万丈$$ and $$ダイターン３$$!」

295:t_106:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(The war with the $$メガノイド$$s is over... But $$クロノ$$ was behind it...)

295:t_106:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(...My revenge is over... From here on, I will dedicate this life to the future of humanity.)

295:t_106:2.en:
$$万丈$$
(The future comes even if we don't become $$メガノイド$$s...! I'll prove it!)

295:t_107:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...How pitiful you are.」

295:t_107:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I fight...! To set you free... to call peace to the universe!」

295:t_108:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The four $$スフィア$$ within me...」

295:t_108:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Soon I'll understand... how to use this power...」

295:t_109:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
(I heard from the people of $$インサラウム$$ that no one lives in this Valles Marineris on Mars...)

295:t_109:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Master... I don't know where you are now, but $$ノノ$$ believes you're surely doing well...)

295:t_109:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
($$ノノ$$ will do her best too...! Believing that someday $$ノノ$$ will become like $$ノノリリ$$...!)

無限獄.evidence: Asakim's prison ('Infinity Prison' to match settled 無限拳 = Infinity Punch); not in glossary sheet
